name: Cloud Of Glory
overview: The 'Cloud of Glory' in Scripture represents God's visible presence and guidance among His people, as seen when the glory of the LORD covered Mount Sinai and Moses entered the cloud for forty days (Exodus 24:16-18). This cloud served as a divine signal for Israel's movements during their wilderness journey, marking when they should camp or travel, remaining over the tabernacle as a sign of God's abiding presence and protection (Numbers 9:17-19). These passages reveal the cloud as both a manifestation of God's glory and a practical means by which He led and guarded His covenant people.
